claims.text: Standard Chartered's custody for RLUSD on the XRP Ledger is live for eligible institutional clients through its DFSA-regulated DIFC branch.
LMAX, Ripple and Standard Chartered intend to make RLUSD eligible collateral on agreed LMAX products via collateral mirroring, subject to documentation, testing, regulation and approvals.
RLUSD circulating supply was about $2.45 billion on 12 October 2026, $1.30 billion on Ethereum and $1.14 billion on XRPL.
Ripple and LMAX announced a partnership in January 2026.

seo.title: Standard Chartered RLUSD Custody and LMAX Collateral Plan Explained
seo.description: Standard Chartered launched institutional custody for Ripple's RLUSD on the XRP Ledger on 12 October 2026 and plans, with LMAX, to let it back trades as collateral. What is live, what is not, and why it matters.

aeo.directAnswer: On 12 October 2026 Standard Chartered launched institutional custody for Ripple USD (RLUSD) on the XRP Ledger through its DFSA-regulated DIFC branch. LMAX Group, Ripple and the bank also plan to make RLUSD eligible collateral on agreed LMAX products using the bank's collateral mirroring model, so tokens stay in bank custody while LMAX recognises their value; that part still needs documentation, testing and approvals.
questions: Can LMAX clients use RLUSD as collateral?
